criteria.notes: Both portrait targets read as one grouped Andon instrument and cover mixed, normal, stopped, unknown, empty, dense, partial, invalid, and live-update states.
No external visual reference was supplied; TASK.md and the instruction-led generation brief are the review authority.
The continuous signal spine, distinct marker geometry, ruled line headers, and flat station lanes form a purpose-built production instrument.
Severity headline, state glyphs, station names, and elapsed values remain prominent at 1080 and the narrower 480-pixel target.
Dark, light, and semantic state surfaces preserve readable text and clear Normal, Attention, Stopped, and Unknown hierarchy.
Long titles auto-fit, line and station labels ellipsize deliberately, reasons wrap within two lines, and all inspected text retains complete ink.
The fixed header and footer frame a flexible uninterrupted line body; dense, sparse, empty, and continued pages remain balanced without overlap.
The packaged Northstar icon and coordinated palettes render cleanly with no missing resources, decorative gradients, or theme inconsistencies.
The vertical industrial signal rail and line-group composition are distinct from the scaffold examples and avoid dashboard-card visual grammar.
